evidence: Medina — UT Plant Resources Center records the Hays study plant as introduced from a cliff above the Medina River in Medina County.
Uvalde — Harvard University Herbaria records E.J. Palmer specimen 11337 from Uvalde and additional Sabinal material.
Val Verde — official Devils River/Dan A. Hughes landscape inventory and Laughlin AFB natural-resources inventory explicitly document Salvia ballotiflora in Val Verde County.
target_zone_range.guardrail: No county presence inferred from source-pool membership or cultivated records.

morphology.look_here_first: First decide whether it is a woody sage: Shrubby Blue Sage is a densely branched shrub/subshrub with very small hairy serrate leaves and small blue-purple flowers.
diagnostic_traits: small ovate leaves with serrate/wavy margins

confusers.separator: Both are woody. S. ballotiflora has much smaller, inconspicuous blue-purple flowers and distinctly small hairy leaves; autumn sage usually has larger showier flowers and a different compact shrub habit.
